poses.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE COMPLETE transparent RGBA low-poly COW animation drawing, pose 0, not a sprite sheet.
Reference image1 is the animator's pose sketch. Match the precise complete pose of image1, especially all FOUR hoof-tip positions, the distinct near/front versus far/front leg connections, elbow and hock bends. Do not copy its visible cutout joints or seams; completely redraw the animal as a continuous sculpted 3D low-poly cow.
Reference image2 is the FINISHED ART rendering from another pose of the SAME cow. Preserve its exact character identity, face, horns, black-white patch contours, udder, tail shape, soft dimensional low-poly lighting/material, and apparent torso/head size. Ignore image2's hoof placement: feet MUST follow image1 instead. Reference image3 is original identity backup only.
Registration: landscape canvas ideally 1485x1059, same camera/perspective/body center and proportions as image2. Torso, head and patch positions stay visually stable; draw the changed four-leg pose from image1, plus only subtle shoulder/hip weight shift. Foot pattern must not revert to reference2. It is a chronological walking pose, ALL FOUR limbs connected with hoof locations from image1, no missing paws or floating joints. The outside near forefoot must visibly change its x position relative to the shoulder according to image1. Keep naturally staggered forefeet, not synchronized.
Repaint every pixel of anatomy: no pasted mesh/cutout fragments, seamless fur/skin, anatomically correct shoulders, wrists, hips, knees, hocks. Preserve exact reference1 pose geometry and make natural articulated silhouette. Clean alpha with generous margins. No scenery, floor, cast shadow, grass, props, text, grid, colored guide strokes or labels. Entire cow facing LEFT, complete horns/tail/four hooves.
poses.QA: Whole body/skin redrawn with smooth leg connections; four hooves complete; no guide blue/color leakage; forepaw positions vary relative to shoulder following sketch. Actual size measured separately below. Geometry must be registered using whole camera and stable torso anchors, not per-frame bounding boxes.

poses.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE SINGLE complete transparent low-poly cow animation drawing, not a sprite sheet, not a video.
Reference image1 is ONLY the animator's pose sketch: preserve its exact camera, character scale, torso anchor, silhouette and spatial positions of all FOUR hoof tips. Reference image2 is ONLY the cow appearance/style/identity: black-white patch pattern, pink nose, brown horns, soft brown friendly eyes, udder and faceted sculpted shading. Do NOT copy reference2's stationary foot placement.
Fully REDRAW the entire cow in the pose of image1, with coherent beautifully connected shoulders, elbows, wrists, hips and hocks. Remove every cutout seam at joints visible in the pose sketch. No composited pasted parts, no rigid segmented puppet appearance.
The near FORELEG is the outside white limb attached to the visible shoulder under the large black neck patch. Trace it continuously to its hoof at about canvas x42%, y93%. The FAR foreleg lies behind it and ends near canvas x38%, y92%. NEAR hind ends at x85%, y93% and FAR hind at x68%, y92%, respecting exact hoof locations in image1. Keep four separate complete natural legs attached to the torso, even if overlapping. Do not put both forefeet together and do not straighten the pose back to a standing reference2. The final is a whole anatomically correct cow in a walking contact pose, facing LEFT, no changes to camera/view/palette/markings.
Maintain image1's framing/registration on a landscape canvas: same body proportions, nose at x5%, rump at x90%, keep complete horns/tail/all feet. All background transparent RGBA, no floor, grass, shadows, props, labels, borders, mosaic/noise or guide colors. Clean transparent margin and smooth antialias edges.

frames.fullPrompt: EDIT ONE SINGLE COMPLETE existing low-poly sculpted cow walking cel on transparent RGBA, not a sprite atlas. Image 1 is the current finished animal painting. Preserve its full camera canvas, head/eyes/ears/body/torso markings, palette, lighting, silhouette and body position/scale exactly. Image 2 is only a PRIVATE limb pose sketch: use it only to understand which front leg is lifting; DO NOT copy its square cut seams, rectangular paws or its pixels. Fully PAINT continuous connected real anatomy in the finished original art. Lift ONLY the NEAR FORELEG: the large visible outer/front leg directly below the black shoulder patch, presently its larger hoof is on the RIGHT of the smaller far front hoof. Flex its carpal wrist naturally and swing its hoof a little forward, leaving a CLEAR AIR GAP of 6-8% canvas height above the ground line. The SMALLER FAR FORELEG on its left stays planted. Both hind legs remain planted. Preserve the black/cream coat markings and udder. This is ONE-FOOT-SWING of a FOUR-BEAT WALK, NOT trot: exactly one front foot airborne and the other THREE limbs bear weight on the same ground level. Preserve all three supporting limbs. Do not raise either hind leg or the other front leg. The hoof/paw must be conspicuously airborne, not merely shifted along the floor. Keep connected joints, compact natural hoof/black-clawed paw, no rectangular projections, detached limb, extra or missing foot. Friendly adult matching existing low-poly art, not photoreal or flat cartoon. No text, guides, floor, shadow, duplicate animal or background. Keep same full image 1 canvas ratio and fixed torso camera, do not center/reframe the animal.
references: Original source full pose preserved; current selected frame replaces it.
